items.title: Revenge of the Baskerville Bloodhound
items.description:
Raised to kill like a pack of loyal hounds, the Baskerville children took countless lives as a band of fearsome assassins. Despite being the shunned illegitimate son of the brood, Vikir served his family faithfully, only to meet his untimely demise at his father’s hands. But when he is inexplicably reborn with a second chance at life, Vikir, armed with the memories and knowledge of his past, swears to rise above the pack and take his revenge. This time, he's ready to bite the hand that feeds.

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: Absolute Sword Sense
items.description:
For as long as he can remember, Woonhwi So has been the black sheep of his family and clan. Because his spirit core has been destroyed, he has no choice but to serve as a third-rate spy for the Blood Cult. One day, during his mission to find the legendary Blade Scroll, he is killed and sent 10 years into the past. When Woonhwi regains consciousness, he realizes that he has been sent back to the day he was kidnapped by the Blood Cult, and that he has gained a mysterious ability to hear the voice of a dagger.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Best Teacher Baek
items.description:
Once the finest instructor in the Blood Cult, Suryong Baek is killed, only to wake up in the body of someone who teaches martial arts at a small rural academy. His new body may be weak, but he knows how to fix it, and it’s not the first time that he’s found himself in a body that can’t access its inner power. Curing his body requires money, however, and Suryong decides that becoming the greatest instructor at a top academy is the best way to do it. Since he’ll be up against tough competition, Suryong will have to use everything he’s got to become a teaching superstar.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The White Tower’s Rogue Mage
items.description:
Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Kkul Ppalgo Sipeun Cheonjae Gyosunim
items.description:
Born into poverty, our protagonist endured endless hardship, becoming a master salesman and being named the "King of Groveling." His dream? It was to retire early and live the good life. But while playing a client company’s game for work, he somehow ends up transported into the game world. And of all characters, he becomes Van Ecclesia, an utterly incompetent, infamous good-for-nothing who is practically useless at everything... but hey, that’s actually perfect! He’s a diamond spoon with good looks, high status, and wealth. And since he's incapable of doing anything, all he has to do is spend the rest of his life eating, playing, and enjoying himself! But then…

“You have awakened the Archmage trait!”

“You have awakened the Myriad Talents trait!”

“You have awakened the Black Flame Dragon’s Charisma…”

Ah, I don’t need any abilities!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
